PageTitle.zh: 主分支更新及Q&A第一部分

name.zh: 帚石南，毒蝇伞和更新日志 #34
name.en: Heather, Fly Agaric and Patch Notes #34
name.ja: Heather, Fly Agaric and Patch Notes #34

Content.zh: 大家好！ 今天我们更新了游戏的主分支，其包含了过去几周添加到测试分支的所有内容。 我们还将发布Q&A环节的第一批回答： Q&A第一部分： 感谢大家在问答环节提问。我们决定将回答分散在几个不同的公告中，以免篇幅过长！ 如果您的问题尚未得到解答，请放心，回答很快就会在后续的公告中公布。如果您想提问但尚未提问，也不用担心，您仍然可以继续提问，我们会在之后的问答环节中为您解答。:) 此外，对于已经提出的类似的问题，这些问题会被缩减或合并以适配问答环节的格式，希望我没有因此遗漏任何内容！ 1) 如果我们把铲子拖到环境卡上，能挖到泥土吗？ 我们可以实装这项功能。:) 2) 《卡牌生存》的灵感是什么？ 没有什么特别的灵感。我想应该什么都借鉴了。我一直很喜欢生存游戏。《漫漫长夜》、《虚幻世界（UnReal World）》、《绿色地狱》都是我很喜欢的游戏。 我之前和 Plissken 一起制作过一个纯文本/菜单类的生存游戏原型。有一天，他来找我散步，我们突然萌生了把它改造成原始生存卡牌游戏的想法。我们开始着手制作，最终其变成了《卡牌生存：热带岛屿》！ 3) 您是否曾想/尝试在《热带岛屿》中加入一些特别的功能或想法，但由于某种原因未能实现？ 很多：真正的海上航行、程序自生成岛屿、复杂的NPC、更具创意的系统等等……幸运的是，其中一些想法已计划在《奇幻森林》中实现或部分实现。 4) 最喜欢的新/旧游戏？ 很难知道您最喜欢的游戏有哪些，但以下这些游戏对我们的生活很重要： Gwim：《毁灭公爵3D》、《星际争霸》、《异形大战铁血战士2》、《矮人要塞》、《漫漫长夜》。 Plissken：《塞尔达传说：织梦岛》、《半条命2》、《方舟》、《任天堂明星大乱斗》、《极乐迪斯科》。 Neomare：《魔法门之英雄无敌III：埃拉西亚的光复》、《超越光速（FTL）》、《战锤：末世鼠疫2》、《卡牌生存：热带岛屿》、《Tainted Grail: Conquest (污痕圣杯)》 5) 未来有计划整合Steam创意工坊吗？我觉得如果模组制作更容易、更普及的话，初代游戏的寿命和影响力会更长。 是的，我们计划整合Steam创意工坊。我们希望《奇幻森林》尽可能地支持模组制作。不过，这得等到游戏更加完善之后才能实现。目前我们手头上的事情已经够忙了。:) 6) 会像《热带岛屿》那样设置结局吗？ 是的，我们计划设置多种结局（至少4种）。一旦我们认为游戏中有足够的内容来支持这些结局，就会加入它们。 7) 新的技能系统预计会有所变化吗？ 在我们结束抢先体验阶段之前，技能系统将经历多次迭代。我们正在尝试通过逐步提升玩家的技能硬上限来加快技能提升的速度，同时引入新的内容。只要你愿意肝，你仍然可以精通任何技能，但随着更多内容的加入，提升技能会变得越来越容易。 8) 会像一代一样加入不同的角色/场景吗？ 是的，我们即将推出4位角色。目前，我们只是在等待更多森林区域及其内容到位。一旦有足够的内容，我们就会开始逐一添加它们。具体情况可能会有所变化，但目前的角色列表如下： - 女巫： 拥有良好初始条件的女巫学徒，其角色进度包含了觅食、农业和魔法相关的内容。 - 猎人： 一位近乎全副武装的准备狩猎传奇猎物的角色，有时也会被其猎物猎杀。 - 穿越者： 肥宅回归！一个在恶劣环境下开局的进阶角色，他必须在这个新世界中找到自己的生态位，或许还能找到爱情并组建家庭！ - 人兽： 像美人鱼一样难以驾驭的角色。这场冒险充满野性和游牧气息，在生死边缘求生，集结你的族群，成为森林之王！ 9) 你对游戏难度有什么规划？鉴于这款游戏比热带岛屿规模更大，你计划在未来几年保持其目前的难度，还是计划在第一年后让游戏更具沙盒风格？ 可能两者兼具，根据玩家的游戏风格，游戏可能会更具挑战性或更具沙盒风格。 我们的想法是在后期不断引入难点。有些难点是随机的，但有些将基于你的行动。 以下是一些后期难点的举例： - 更冷的年份 - 更干旱的年份 - 作物枯萎 - 精神/灵性问题 - 满足商人交易需求 - 满足家人、朋友和其他NPC的需求 - 独特的危险野兽 10) 木炭粉的用途是什么？ 目前的作用是治疗腹泻。未来会有更多的用途。 11) 你们有驯服系统的计划吗？ 是的。目前只有灰山鹑和野猪可以被驯服，但最终我们希望玩家能够驯服几乎所有动物，从熊到松鼠。当然，有些动物即使被驯服后仍然会很野，但这个选项是会存在的。 12) 未来我们是否有可能看到更强大的激励机制来保持角色情绪高昂？ 当然会有。尤其是在我们不断调整完善免疫系统等方面，以及引入更多精神/灵性相关的机制（包括孤独感）之后。 13) 当我们能让NPC受孕或被受孕时，我们会有真正意义上的需要照顾的婴儿并能看着它们逐渐长大吗？养育的婴儿数量上有上限吗？ 是的，你将能养育真正意义上的必须被照顾的婴儿，看着它们长大并制造麻烦。:) 最终它们也会长大成人。我认为我们不会对你能养育多少个婴儿设上限，但如果数量太多，游戏性能可能会受到影响。 14) 你对食物中细菌系统的最终目标是什么？有些食物在达到100%的细菌含量后会腐烂吗？ 大多数食物在达到最大细菌含量时应该已经腐烂了。如果有任何特定的食物没有腐烂，请告诉我们，我们会修复它！ 除此之外，我们仍然需要不断迭代并平衡免疫系统以及你从食物中获得的细菌量。 15) 除了猪和鸟之外，还能饲养其他生物吗？也许是鹿或獾？或者是未来的新生物？ 是的。我们希望让玩家有机会驯服和饲养各种类型的生物。这包括乌鸦、松鼠、熊、狼，以及游戏中能找到的任何动物。但凡游戏中包含的动物，我们希望玩家能够驯服和饲养它们。 16) 烹饪系统何时发布？它会提供增益效果吗？ 烹饪系统已经部分发布，但仍缺少许多功能，包括一些尤为重要的功能。 我们的下一次更新应该会发布一些反馈的改进，让享用美味食物的行为更有满足感。烹饪系统的下一个改进是创建自己的食谱。这些食谱将与你的蓝图一起存储，以便你随时重新制作。基本上，有点像《热带岛屿》中的食谱，但由你自行设计。 对于这个系统所提供的增益效果，最贴近理想状态下的是通过组合特定的食物类型来获得增益。目前，这主要体现在幸福度增益（会影响情绪）上，最终也会体现在饱食度和食物厌倦度上。 17) 附魔了精魄的护身符放在包里仍然有效。我个人认为这不算是bug。为什么放在包里就失效了？ 您是否是在主版本而不是已经修复此问题的测试版本上玩的？如果不是，是不是我们遗漏了什么附魔？如果阅读本文后问题仍然存在，请告知我们，我们会尽快修复。 游戏世界中的解释是，附魔物品需要穿戴在身上才能生效，而不是被遗忘在包里。:) 设计上的解释是，我们一直在平衡附魔，使其成为一种可选的、有助于您游戏风格的物品，而不是生存的必需品。因此，虽然我们不想阻止玩家为所有装备附魔，但我们也不想煽动这种行为，因为我们认为这会有点繁琐，而且与游戏的其他部分格格不入。让玩家可以在所有衣服之外的包里携带数十种附魔，这有点过分，也过于强大，以至于我们无法妥善平衡游戏的其他部分。 18) 您对这款游戏的最终愿景是什么？您希望它最终变成什么样？ 我们希望这款游戏成为一个小型的生活模拟器。我们想要一个有深度的沙盒游戏，它既具有挑战性，又足够开放多样，让人感觉与现实保持一致；让玩家可以用它来探索自我、满足他们的需求和愿望。如果让我放开地回答这个问题，我想说我的梦想是让人们感觉自己在这片森林里过着一种相比于现实生活稍微简化的生活，并利用它来更多地接触本我。当然，这可能不会实现，但哪怕能达到这个目标的百分之一，我也会很高兴！ 19) 如果计划是根据玩家反馈逐步塑造游戏，你们如何确保开发节奏能够跟上反馈的速度？ 我们的开发流程非常有机（扁平化），并且会根据玩家反馈进行调整，但它仍然有一个大致的愿景和计划。 我们为这个项目投入了大量的设计工作，它包含一张非常大的森林地图、一条非常长的进度内容、规划好的各种系统以及更多相互关联的功能。此愿景和计划就像一个框架，让我们可以在不迷失方向的情况下添加诸多内容。 我们认为，通过我们的开发工具和计划框架，我们能够大量添加玩家请求的功能和系统改进，而不会因此拖慢太多进度。我们认为这是《卡牌生存》系列的特色之一。:) 20) 你们将使用什么样的系统来持续有效地收集玩家的意见？ 我们通常从 Discord 和 Steam 论坛的评论中获得大部分反馈，因为这些平台是我们最容易访问的。我们也会从中文社区的朋友那里收到一些报告。（指QQ群，译者注） 随着游戏内bug反馈功能的加入，我们现在可以收集任何人的意见，无论他们是否访问任何平台。我们希望通过像这样频繁发布游戏内外的Q&A公告，能够让我们更好地了解大家的想法！ 今天的问答就到这里。下周我们会继续解答更多问题！ 本周晚些时候，我们将发布新的内容更新，敬请期待！
Content.en: Hello everyone! Today we're finally updating the main branch of the game with all the things we've been adding to the beta branch over the last few weeks. We're also posting our first wave of answers from the Q&A: Q&A 1: Thank you all for sending your questions for the Q&A. We decided that we'll be spreading our answers over a few different announcements so that they won't become too long! If your questions haven't been answered yet don't worry, they will be in future announcements soon. And if you wanted to ask a question but haven't yet don't worry either, you can still ask it and we'll answer it in a future Q&A. :) Also, some of the questions had to be shortened to fit the Q&A format or merged because another similar question already existed, hope I didn't miss anything because of that! 1) Could we dig for dirt if we aim the shovel to the location? Yes, we could implement that again. :) 2) What were the inspirations for Card Survival? There wasn't any specific inspiration. I guess a bit of everything. I always liked survival games very much. The Long Dark, Unreal World, Green Hell, are all games I enjoyed quite a bit. We already had made a prototype for a text/menu only survival game with Plissken in the past and one day, when he was visiting and we were going for a walk, we had the idea to turn it into a survival prehistoric card game. We started working on it and it eventually turned into Card Survival: Tropical Island! 3) Were there any particular features or ideas you wanted to/tried to include in tropical island but couldn't for whatever reason? Lots of things: Proper Sailing, Procedural Islands, complex NPCs, more creative systems, and many other things... Fortunately, some of these ideas are planned to be implemented or already partly implemented in Fantasy Forest. 4) Favorite games both old and new? It's hard to know which are your favourite games but some of the games that have been important in our lives are: Gwim: Duke Nukem 3D, Starcraft, AVP2, Dwarf Fortress, The Long Dark. Plissken: Link's Awakening, Half-Life 2, Ark, Super Smash Bros, Disco Elysium. Neomare: Heroes of Might & Magic 3, FTL, Vermintide 2, CS:TI, Tainted Grail: Conquest 5) Is Steam Workshop integration planned for the future? I feel like the first game would have had much more longevity and reach if modding had been easier and more widespread. Yes, Steam Workshop integration is planned. We want to make Fantasy Forest as mod friendly as we can. This will have to wait until the game is a lot more advanced however. For now we have our hands full. :) 6) Will there be victory conditions like in Tropical Island? Yes, there are multiple victory conditions planned (at least 4). They will be introduced once we feel like there's enough content in the game for them. 7) Are changes expected to come to the skill novelty system? Skill gain is going to go through a lot of iterations before we leave Early Access. We are trying to pace skill gains in players by gradually raising their practical skill caps as we introduce new content. You can still become a master at any skill if you're willing to grind but this will become easier as more content is added. 8) Will there be different characters/szenarios like in the first part? Yes, we have 4 characters coming. For now we're just waiting for more of the forest and its content to be in place. Once there's enough we'll start adding them one by one. Things might change but the current character list is: - The Witch: An apprentice witch with good starting conditions and whose progression contains a mixture of foraging, agriculture and magic. - The Hunter: A character that is mostly geared towards hunting ever greater prey, and sometimes being hunted in return. - Isekai'd Tourist: The old tourist makes a return! An advanced character that starts in dire conditions and has to find his place in this new world, and perhaps find love and start a family! - The Man-Beast: A difficult character like the mermaid. This adventure is a feral and nomadic one, mostly about surviving on the edge and eventually assembling your pack and becoming the king of the forest! 9) What are your plans for difficulty? Given this game is larger than tropical island, do you plan for the game to keep its difficulty into further years, or do you plan the game to be more sand-boxy after the first year? Probably a mix of both, but depending on your playstyle it could become more challenging or sandboxy. Our idea is to keep introducing challenges in the later years. Some will just be random, but others will be based on your actions. Here are some examples of late years challenges: - Colder Years - Drier Years - Crop Blights - Mental/Spiritual Issues. - Meeting trading demands. - Meeting Family, Friends and other NPC demands. - Unique Dangerous Beasts. 10) What is the charcoal powder intended to use for? For now, treating diarrhoea. More uses will come in the future. 11) Do you have any plans for a taming system? Yes. Currently only partridges and boars can be tamed but eventually we would like players to be able to tame just about anything, from bears to squirrels. Some animals will of course still be quite wild even after being tamed but the option will be there. 12) Is there any chance we might see stronger incentives to maintain high Morale in the future? Yes definitely. Especially once we introduce more mental/spiritual issues (including loneliness), but also as we continue to tweak things like the immune system. 13) When we do get the last big update on npcs and the ability to impregnate or get impregnated, will we have actual babies to take care of and watch them grow up? Will there be a cap to how many babies you can have? Yes, you will have actual babies you have to take care of and watch grow up and cause trouble. :) Eventually they should become adults too. I don't think we'll have a cap on how many babies you can have, but performance will probably suffer if you go too crazy. 14) What are your end goals for the bacteria system in food? Will some food items rot after they reach 100% bacteria? Most items should already rot if they reach maximum bacteria. If there's any specific item that is not rotting let us know and we'll fixt it! Other than that we still need to iterate on and improve the balancing of the immune system and the amount of bacteria you get from food. 15) Is it possible to raise creatures other than pigs and birds? Maybe deer or badgers? Or new creatures of the future? Yes. We want to give players the chance to both tame and raise all types of creatures. This will include crows, squirrels, bears, wolves, and basically any animal you can find in the game. If it's in the game we want players to be able to tame them and breed them. 16) When will the cooking system be released? Will it provide buffs? The cooking system is already partly released, although it's still missing many features, including some important ones. Our next patch should be releasing some feedback improvements so that the act of eating tasty food can feel more rewarding. The next improvement coming to the cooking system after that is the ability to create your own recipes. These recipes will be stored with your blueprints so that you can easily remake them whenever you want. Basically, a bit like the recipes in Tropical island but designed by you. The closest thing this system has and will have to buffs, is the ability to get bonuses from combining the right types of foods. This is currently mostly reflected in wellbeing bonuses (which have an effect on morale) and will eventually also reflect on satiation and food saturation. 17) Amulets that have been enchanted with spirit power still work when stored in a bag. Personally, I don’t think this should be considered a bug. Why shouldn’t they work when stored in a bag? Is it possible you were playing on the main branch instead of the beta one where this fix was? If that's not the case perhaps there's some enchantment we missed? If it's still happening after reading this please let us know and we'll get it fixed as soon as possible. The in-world explanation is that an enchanted item needs to be close to your person to work, not forgotten in a bag among many. :) The design explanation is that we've been balancing enchantments to work as an optional thing that can help your playstyle, not as a requirement for survival. So while we don't want to stop players from enchanting all their equipment if they want to, we also don't want to foment that as we think that would be a bit of a chore and not vibe that well with the rest of the game. Giving players the possibility to carry dozens of enchantments in bags, on top of all their clothes is also a bit too much and too overpowered for us to be able to balance the rest of the game properly. 18) What is your ultimate vision for this game? What do you hope it will eventually become? We'd like this game to become a little life simulation. We want a deep sandbox that is challenging and coherent enough to feel real, while open and varied enough that players can use it to explore themselves, their needs and their desires. If I'm allowed to go full delirious with this answer, I'd say my dream would be for people to feel like they are living a little simplified life in this forest and use it to get more in touch with their true selves. Of course, it probably won't get to be that, but if it gets to be even a 1/100th of that I will be happy! 19) If the plan is to shape the game gradually based on player feedback, how do you ensure that the development pace can keep up with the speed of that feedback? Our development process is quite organic and open to change based on player feedback but it still has a vision and a plan. A lot of design work has gone into this project, and it includes a very large forest map, a very long content progression, planned systems and more features that all connect to each other. This vision and plan acts as a frame in which we can add lots of things without losing direction. We feel that through our development tools and our plan frame we are able to add player requested features and system improvements quite a bit without being slowed down too much. We feel this is one of the special things of the Card Survival series. :) 20) What kind of system will you use to consistently and effectively collect input from players? We traditionally get most of our feedback from Discord and from comments in the Steam forums since those are the platforms most accessible to us. We also get some reports from our friends in the Chinese community. With the addition of the in-game bug report feature we can now also collect input from anyone regardless of their access to any platform and we are hoping that by having frequent in-game Q&A announcements like this one we can keep ourselves more aware of what people have on their minds! That's all the questions we'll be answering today. We'll answer more next week! See you later in the week for the new content patch!

You can still become a master at any skill if you're willing to grind but this will become easier as more content is added. 8) Will there be different characters/szenarios like in the first part? Yes, we have 4 characters coming. For now we're just waiting for more of the forest and its content to be in place. Once there's enough we'll start adding them one by one. Things might change but the current character list is: - The Witch: An apprentice witch with good starting conditions and whose progression contains a mixture of foraging, agriculture and magic. - The Hunter: A character that is mostly geared towards hunting ever greater prey, and sometimes being hunted in return. - Isekai'd Tourist: The old tourist makes a return! An advanced character that starts in dire conditions and has to find his place in this new world, and perhaps find love and start a family! - The Man-Beast: A difficult character like the mermaid. This adventure is a feral and nomadic one, mostly about surviving on the edge and eventually assembling your pack and becoming the king of the forest! 9) What are your plans for difficulty? Given this game is larger than tropical island, do you plan for the game to keep its difficulty into further years, or do you plan the game to be more sand-boxy after the first year? Probably a mix of both, but depending on your playstyle it could become more challenging or sandboxy. Our idea is to keep introducing challenges in the later years. Some will just be random, but others will be based on your actions. Here are some examples of late years challenges: - Colder Years - Drier Years - Crop Blights - Mental/Spiritual Issues. - Meeting trading demands. - Meeting Family, Friends and other NPC demands. - Unique Dangerous Beasts. 10) What is the charcoal powder intended to use for? For now, treating diarrhoea. More uses will come in the future. 11) Do you have any plans for a taming system? Yes. Currently only partridges and boars can be tamed but eventually we would like players to be able to tame just about anything, from bears to squirrels. Some animals will of course still be quite wild even after being tamed but the option will be there. 12) Is there any chance we might see stronger incentives to maintain high Morale in the future? Yes definitely. Especially once we introduce more mental/spiritual issues (including loneliness), but also as we continue to tweak things like the immune system. 13) When we do get the last big update on npcs and the ability to impregnate or get impregnated, will we have actual babies to take care of and watch them grow up? Will there be a cap to how many babies you can have? Yes, you will have actual babies you have to take care of and watch grow up and cause trouble. :) Eventually they should become adults too. I don't think we'll have a cap on how many babies you can have, but performance will probably suffer if you go too crazy. 14) What are your end goals for the bacteria system in food? Will some food items rot after they reach 100% bacteria? Most items should already rot if they reach maximum bacteria. If there's any specific item that is not rotting let us know and we'll fixt it! Other than that we still need to iterate on and improve the balancing of the immune system and the amount of bacteria you get from food. 15) Is it possible to raise creatures other than pigs and birds? Maybe deer or badgers? Or new creatures of the future? Yes. We want to give players the chance to both tame and raise all types of creatures. This will include crows, squirrels, bears, wolves, and basically any animal you can find in the game. If it's in the game we want players to be able to tame them and breed them. 16) When will the cooking system be released? Will it provide buffs? The cooking system is already partly released, although it's still missing many features, including some important ones. Our next patch should be releasing some feedback improvements so that the act of eating tasty food can feel more rewarding. The next improvement coming to the cooking system after that is the ability to create your own recipes. These recipes will be stored with your blueprints so that you can easily remake them whenever you want. Basically, a bit like the recipes in Tropical island but designed by you. The closest thing this system has and will have to buffs, is the ability to get bonuses from combining the right types of foods. This is currently mostly reflected in wellbeing bonuses (which have an effect on morale) and will eventually also reflect on satiation and food saturation. 17) Amulets that have been enchanted with spirit power still work when stored in a bag. Personally, I don’t think this should be considered a bug. Why shouldn’t they work when stored in a bag? Is it possible you were playing on the main branch instead of the beta one where this fix was? If that's not the case perhaps there's some enchantment we missed? If it's still happening after reading this please let us know and we'll get it fixed as soon as possible. The in-world explanation is that an enchanted item needs to be close to your person to work, not forgotten in a bag among many. :) The design explanation is that we've been balancing enchantments to work as an optional thing that can help your playstyle, not as a requirement for survival. So while we don't want to stop players from enchanting all their equipment if they want to, we also don't want to foment that as we think that would be a bit of a chore and not vibe that well with the rest of the game. Giving players the possibility to carry dozens of enchantments in bags, on top of all their clothes is also a bit too much and too overpowered for us to be able to balance the rest of the game properly. 18) What is your ultimate vision for this game? What do you hope it will eventually become? We'd like this game to become a little life simulation. We want a deep sandbox that is challenging and coherent enough to feel real, while open and varied enough that players can use it to explore themselves, their needs and their desires. If I'm allowed to go full delirious with this answer, I'd say my dream would be for people to feel like they are living a little simplified life in this forest and use it to get more in touch with their true selves. Of course, it probably won't get to be that, but if it gets to be even a 1/100th of that I will be happy! 19) If the plan is to shape the game gradually based on player feedback, how do you ensure that the development pace can keep up with the speed of that feedback? Our development process is quite organic and open to change based on player feedback but it still has a vision and a plan. A lot of design work has gone into this project, and it includes a very large forest map, a very long content progression, planned systems and more features that all connect to each other. This vision and plan acts as a frame in which we can add lots of things without losing direction. We feel that through our development tools and our plan frame we are able to add player requested features and system improvements quite a bit without being slowed down too much. We feel this is one of the special things of the Card Survival series. :) 20) What kind of system will you use to consistently and effectively collect input from players? We traditionally get most of our feedback from Discord and from comments in the Steam forums since those are the platforms most accessible to us. We also get some reports from our friends in the Chinese community. With the addition of the in-game bug report feature we can now also collect input from anyone regardless of their access to any platform and we are hoping that by having frequent in-game Q&A announcements like this one we can keep ourselves more aware of what people have on their minds! That's all the questions we'll be answering today. We'll answer more next week! See you later in the week for the new content patch!
